verdict.rationale: Godot's own docs say you can change the import parameters of several assets at the same time, which is a genuine first-party bulk operation, but it is narrow and thinly described. EditorScript, plugins and headless CLI scripting are only building blocks for constructing bulk operations, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: general multi-item editing beyond import settings (e.g. nodes, scenes, resources), documented bulk operations an agent can invoke programmatically, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
